==============================================================================
PRIVACY POLICY -- DOCS.ERMNVLDMR.COM
==============================================================================

Last Updated:  2026-11-01
Canonical URL: https://static.ermnvldmr.com/docs/privacy-policy.txt
Controller:    Vladimir Eremin <personal@ermnvldmr.com>
Scope:         docs.ermnvldmr.com and ermnvldmr.com services


OVERVIEW & CONTROLLER
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This documentation site (`docs.ermnvldmr.com`) and related `ermnvldmr.com`
services are operated by Vladimir Eremin (`personal@ermnvldmr.com`).

Core privacy commitments:

  * Zero advertising
  * Zero cross-site tracking
  * Zero data brokering
  * Zero tracking cookies


1. ANONYMOUS TELEMETRY (SELF-HOSTED UMAMI)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To understand aggregate traffic patterns and maintain site reliability, we run
a self-hosted instance of open-source Umami Analytics (https://umami.is) on
our own infrastructure. The telemetry script and collection endpoint are
served first-party via `/trace/trace.js` and `/trace/api/send`.

Metrics Collected:
  * Page URL and HTTP referrer
  * Browser type, operating system, and device category
  * Screen resolution and preferred language
  * Coarse country/region lookup

Anonymity & Cookieless Design:
  * No cookies, browser fingerprinting, or persistent client identifiers are
    used.
  * Raw IP addresses are never stored in the analytics database.
  * Distinct sessions are counted solely via a rotating, salted cryptographic
    hash that cannot be reversed to identify an individual visitor.

Opt-Out & Do Not Track:
  * Browser `Do Not Track` (`DNT: 1`) signals are honored automatically
    (`data-do-not-track="true"`).
  * Visitors can also disable Umami telemetry at any time by running the
    following command in their browser developer console:

      localStorage.setItem('umami.disabled', '1')


2. COOKIES & LOCAL STORAGE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

No tracking cookies are set by `docs.ermnvldmr.com`.

Browser `localStorage` is used strictly on the client side to remember your
visual theme preference (`"light"`, `"dark"`, or `"system"`) under the
`color-theme` key. This value remains in your browser and is never transmitted
to any server.


3. INFRASTRUCTURE & EDGE DELIVERY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

DNS resolution, TLS termination, DDoS protection, and static asset delivery
(`static.ermnvldmr.com` via Cloudflare R2) are fronted by Cloudflare, routing
traffic to our self-hosted Kubernetes nodes.

Standard transient HTTP and network metadata (IP address, User-Agent string,
request path, and timestamp) is processed strictly for content delivery,
network security, and abuse prevention.


4. DATA RETENTION & SHARING
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

All analytics records reside exclusively in our self-hosted PostgreSQL
database. Telemetry data is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties.


5. CONTACT
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please
contact:

  Vladimir Eremin
  Email: personal@ermnvldmr.com

==============================================================================
